description_en: Creates a default vSwitch by calling the CreateDefaultVSwitch operation
description_zh: 调用CreateDefaultVSwitch接口创建一个默认的交换机
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-default-vswitch --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDefaultVSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the default vSwitch that you want to create.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的默认交换机所属的可用区ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html接口获取可用区ID。
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the default vSwitch that you want to create.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的默认交换机的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The last 8 bits of the IPv6 CIDR block of the vSwitch. Valid values: 0 to 255
parameters.help_zh: 交换机IPv6网段的最后8比特位，取值：0～255
parameters.name: ipv6_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The ID of the default vSwitch that was created

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the default vSwitch that was created
